description: RFC 0008 stage 2: the unified GameState serves 3..10 seats and must reproduce MultiwayState at 3..6 and the independent N-seat ledger at 7..10. Every mutation below is a semantic change to a rule that is decided by SEAT COUNT in the unified machine (the 3+ profile rather than the heads-up one); the multiway oracle must catch each. Recorded as 11 caught / 1 equivalent. The single equivalent (dropping the folded-seat check from any_pending) is unreachable by construction: a folded seat's pending flag is always false, so the predicate's folded guard is dead -- it is pinned by the measured structural invariant folded==true => pending==false, not by a test that goes green under the mutant, the way the stage-1 battery records its own equivalents. Two mutations guard defects the differential review surfaced in shipped code: a zero-stack non-blind opener missing its all-in derivation preflop (caught by test_multiway and by the lockstep sweep) and a rotated live-seat hole-card mapping at a contested showdown (caught by the differentiated three-way showdown case, since the fixed club board otherwise plays for every hand).

equivalent: any_pending keeps a mid-hand folded seat pending and never closes the street
expected.rationale: The multiway oracle enumerates every legal action across the bounded three-active-seat fixtures for 3..10 seats and cross-checks the REAL MultiwayState in lockstep at 3..6. The mutants target the branches where the unified machine selects the multiway rule instead of the heads-up one (the post-refund all-in re-derivation, no big-blind option, mid-hand folding, the any-pending close, and the seated-blind/rooted-board validation), plus the seat-6 settlement widening. None can be equivalent: each changes a node the walk reaches and compares field-by-field, or a root the validation cases construct.

additional_targets.name: the shipped MultiwayState, which is the 3..6 reference
